description: This source file defines a singleton class 'TalkSystemSpeechSynthesizer' that manages speech synthesis using AVFoundation's AVSpeechSynthesizer. It provides methods to speak text asynchronously with timeout handling, start and stop speech, and implements AVSpeechSynthesizer delegate methods to track speech events.

classes.name: TalkSystemSpeechSynthesizer
classes.description: A singleton class that encapsulates speech synthesis functionalities, including speaking text asynchronously with timeout management and handling start/finish/cancel events.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops ongoing speech and cancels related tasks.

methods.name: speak
methods.description: Performs speech synthesis of provided text with optional language and start callback; includes timeout handling.

methods.name: watchdogTimeoutSeconds
methods.description: Estimates the maximum duration for speech synthesis based on language and text length, used for watchdog timeout.
